Deep Reserves.name: Deep Reserves
Deep Reserves.description:
🏃 Hard daily training has built your stamina.

🔋 You outlast fights, climbs and rescues that wear others out.
📋 Requires level 8 and Conditioning 8.

📈 Grants: Stamina +15
Deep Reserves.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's body has adapted to hard daily training: stronger lungs and legs and faster recovery between efforts. Show it in steady breathing late in a fight and energy to spare after drills. Limits: it adds staying power, not strength or speed, and lost sleep, injury and hunger still drain them.
